0022600221.text: The Denver Nuggets (5-4, coming off a loss) play their 10th game of the 2026-27 season on the road against the Memphis Grizzlies (7-3, 5-0 away from home, on a win streak), with Denver 10th in the West and 4th in the Northwest, 2.5 games back, and Memphis 7th in the West and 3rd in the Southwest, 1.5 games back. Julian Strawther is out for Denver with a knee sprain, while Memphis is without Richie Saunders (knee surgery) and Scotty Pippen Jr. (back soreness), and Isaiah Stewart and Quinten Post are day-to-day game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet this season, and the Nuggets won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 136-119 win in Denver on April 8, 2026.
